title: Receiver captures carry provenance and a pending entry cannot outlive its task
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-19, standards enforcement audit after #1521 (docs/program/standards-enforcement.md). Evidence: KRN-12/r-receiver-tests: test/rules/receiver-evidence.test.mjs accepts any spec/receivers.json entry, including 'pending:', and never checks that a capture is verbatim receiver output.
Files: test/rules/receiver-evidence.test.mjs, spec/receivers.json
Outcome: Each capture entry records its provenance (receiver command, version, sha256 of the capture file) and the rule test fails on a hash mismatch or on a 'pending:' entry whose task is closed or missing.
Proof: node --test test/rules/receiver-evidence.test.mjs: an edited capture and a pending entry naming a closed task each fail.
